# Isaiah Chapter 28 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 29 verses]*

*Proud crown of drunkards; cornerstone in Zion; covenant with death; line upon line; farmer parable*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Behold, I am the one who has laid as a foundation in Zion a stone, a tested stone. This chapter proud crown of drunkards.

*-- LOGOS*
